visual_contract.purpose: human-scale contrast for vehicles and mechs
visual_contract.palette: gray-green cloth and armour, charcoal webbing, faded oxide-red team marks, restrained amber optics
visual_contract.rejection: never toy soldiers, bright faction dots, clone symmetry, glowing-visored sci-fi troopers or oversized weapons

runtime.formation: three-person deployed crew and crew-served gun

runtime_animation.movement_cadence: four authored advance frames per team at 6-8 fps
runtime_animation.combat: rifle team uses restrained five-point muzzle cadence; heavy crew uses target-tracking layered weapon and recoil
runtime_animation.hit_response: real damage sets a short two-stage squad scatter/dust response
runtime_animation.destruction: subdued dust and scatter consequence without wreck fire
